The '''Ashlendu Mountains''' were very tall [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Phateem/Legends|Phateem]], high above the clouds. Within the crags of these mountains was the [[Halls of Knowledge/Legends|Halls of Knowledge]], an ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] storehouse of information, and was once one of the [[Twenty Wonders of the Galaxy]].<ref name="FaDCR" /> Many of the items in its collection were later scattered to other Jedi facilities on planets such as [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] or [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
